description: Future Sight / Doom Desire hit at the end of the turn after next (futuremove onResidual, order 3), in the holders' Speed order. Turn 1 (setup): Slowking's Future Sight at Umbreon, Bronzong's Doom Desire at Snorlax. Turn 2 (setup) and 3: Calm Mind. Turn 3's residual: Future Sight's hit uses `ignoreImmunity: false` (Dark Umbreon is immune) and still costs Slowking its Life Orb recoil; Doom Desire hits Snorlax with Bronzong's +2 SpA. Damage rolls and crits branch.
